name: Group ticket buy
summary: Friends pick a ticket tier together, one person fronts it, and everyone sees their share and marks it sent.
useWhen: buying tickets for a show or game as a group, with a few price tiers
'who's buying the tickets', 'lawn or reserved?', 'split the pit tickets'
dontUseWhen: one person already bought and only the money is left (use split)
only deciding whether to go (use squad-lock)

params.tiers: 1-3 of {name, kind: lawn|rows|pit, priceCents, feeCents, left, together, row?}
params.tier: index of the tier the chat leans to
